concepts.name: Side-by-side review workbench
concepts.summary: A queue of lots, then one review screen with every value next to its limit, a derived verdict and a guarded decision.
concepts.before: Re-key values into a spreadsheet and compare them by eye
concepts.after: See each value next to its limit with an explained verdict and decide on one screen
concepts.riskiest_assumption: Reviewers release from the derived verdict without re-keying (A-01)

concepts.name: Exception-only inbox
concepts.summary: Compliant lots are accepted automatically; reviewers see only exceptions.
concepts.riskiest_assumption: QA accepts releases no person looked at (conflicts with the SOP, E-05)

concepts.name: Guided checklist
concepts.summary: A step-by-step checklist, one parameter per step.
concepts.riskiest_assumption: A checklist is faster than a table for five or more parameters

rationale: Highest weighted score (4.75 vs 3.55 and 3.45) and keeps a human decision on every lot, as the SOP requires (E-05).
